🚨 SCAM ALERT — PLEASE BE CAREFUL! 🚨 One of our Pashtoon brothers living in Belgium was recently scammed by a fake company on Alibaba. He paid around $1,172, and unfortunately, he realized too late that it was a scam. Last night, he reached out to me during a LIVE session and asked for help. InshaAllah, I will try my best to help him recover his money. I’m doing this purely for the sake of Almighty Allah, because we are all brothers, and helping each other and standing together against scammers is something we should do for humanity. 🤲❤️ This brother had actually contacted me before regarding sourcing and shipping, but suddenly disappeared. Then last night, he came back with this unfortunate story. ⚠️ Please learn from this situation: Before sending money to any company or supplier, especially online, verify everything carefully. Don’t trust someone simply because they have a professional-looking profile or website. If you need help with sourcing, shipping, or verifying a supplier, try to contact someone responsible and experienced before making any payment. Don’t wait until you lose your money. Stay alert. Stay safe. Help one another. 🤝❤️ #ScamAlert #AlibabaScam #ScamAwareness #StaySafe #Pashtoon
